members.member: If [code]true[/code], the texture used for this attachment is discardable (see [member RDTextureFormat.is_discardable] and [method RenderingDevice.texture_set_discardable]). A framebuffer's format takes this value from each of its textures when the framebuffer is created, so set it to match those textures to describe the same format (see [method RenderingDevice.framebuffer_get_format]). [RenderingDevice] creates the pipelines for this format against a render pass that discards the attachment's contents instead of storing them, as draw lists do by default for a discardable texture. Some drivers disable optimizations such as fragment density maps on pipelines created for a render pass that stores a multisample attachment.
The number of samples used when sampling the attachment.
The attachment's usage flags, which determine what can be done with it.
